accept.criterion: Family mode masks bad text in names and answers
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/moderation.test.ts -t "family mode masks|standard mode passes|rename cleans"
accept.evidence: in a family room a profane join name and rename are masked in the room snapshot; a player's text answer is masked before the game sees it (own view, modq preview), and no socket's serialized frames contain the raw text; standard mode passes text unchanged

accept.criterion: With reveal-review, the onModeration callback is withheld until a moderator approves, and the stage view shows the item as pending
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/moderation.test.ts -t "onModeration is withheld"
accept.evidence: a spied onModeration is not called for 5 s while the Stage view shows both items pending; a promoted moderator's approve calls it once (approved=true) and the Stage view flips to approved; a host-panel reject calls it with approved=false; the Stage socket never receives modq or the unreviewed text

accept.criterion: A banned token or IP hash cannot rejoin
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/moderation.test.ts -t "banned token or IP hash|BanList keys|production server installs"
accept.evidence: after kick{ban:true} the old token from a new IP and a fresh identity from the banned IP (player, audience, moderator) get BANNED and a closed socket; a plain kick can rejoin; bans are per room code+epoch and dropped with the room; createServer installs the guard end to end over a real ws socket

accept.criterion: A muted player's text actions return MUTED
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/moderation.test.ts -t "muted player's text actions"
accept.evidence: after mod mute the player's text act is acked {ok:false, err:"MUTED"} and never reaches the game; non-text actions are not muted; minutes 0 lifts a mute; the mute expires after its minutes; nobody can mute the host, only the host can mute a moderator, players cannot send mod
